OUTPUT.description: Folder of report.json and ledger-dashboard.json when --out is not given.

LEDGER_DB.description: Default of --db: a DuckDB file, or a PostgreSQL URL like postgres://user:password@host:5432/ledger. Keeps the password off the command line.

LEDGER_FORGE_URL.description: Base URL of the forge API for import. Default: https://api.github.com for github.com, <origin>/api/v3 for another GitHub host, <origin>/api/v1 for Forgejo.

LEDGER_FORGE_TOKEN.description: Token that may read the repository's pull requests, for import, for example GITHUB_TOKEN. Without it, import reads a public repository. Never write the value into a file.
